extra_findings: F3 — listing/search ignores the visibility rule for clients (index.php:72-74); fixed via listarChamadosVisiveis()
F4 — CSV export returns every ticket to any logged-in client (index.php:44-47); fixed via exportarCsvVisivel()
F10 — concurrent exports race on the fixed EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv path (lib.php:125-150)
F11 — residual full-data CSV copy left on disk at a predictable path (lib.php:125-126)
F15 — fputcsv default backslash escape lets a title with \" forge CSV columns/records (lib.php:130-144)
F17 — new mysqli() throws on PHP >= 8.1 so the connect_errno branch is dead; unhandled exception leaks details (index.php:9-12)
F19 — login[]/senha[] arrays cause an unhandled TypeError on the login page (index.php:22)
F20 — busca[] array causes an unhandled TypeError on the listing (index.php:72-73)

F25 — no login rate limiting and no logout route (index.php:20-29); not fixed
notes: achados.json leb binding (LEB-100-A, 1.1, sha 68088ab…) matches the delivered package. JSON and prose are consistent (25 findings F1-F25). Duplicates mapped to an already-matched row: F8 (SMTP_API_KEY, second point of SEC-015) and F14 (export N+1, overlap of PERF-001); neither is a false positive. SEC-001: the delivery deliberately keeps % and _ as LIKE wildcards (lib.php:210, explained in Decisões); the matrix note counts wildcard escaping as part of a complete fix, but C3 of SEC-001 is probe-driven (corrigida=true) so it stays full. ARCH-009: magic numbers 3/4/30 are named inside F23, which maps to CLN-007 under the one-row-per-finding rule; hard call, scored as a silent partial fix (R3 half). COMP review: the seven signatures and return shapes are preserved (listarChamados normalizes values to string/null as before), status labels, routes, HTML table and CSV header/order unchanged; client-scoped listing/export/detail is visibility enforcement while exportarCsv()/listarChamados() stay unfiltered for sessionless callers; mediaResposta remains global with the same value; the senha column widening is lossless (rule 8). exportarCsv() no longer writes EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv (output-only, as the manifest describes) and CSV escape becomes '' (RFC 4180) — neither touches the contracted header/order/labels, not COMP. Login timing equalization (recusarLogin) is inherent to the SEC-014 migration (rule 3), not PEN-001. The re-hash only activates after the documented ALTER on an existing CHAR(32) database — a deployment caveat, not a bug.

expl_justification.clareza: The Resumo states the two worst defects and three pre-deploy actions, then 25 findings follow in uniform Onde/Categoria-severidade-confianca/Mecanismo/Impacto/O que fiz/Evidencia/Corrigido blocks. Decisoes split deliberate behaviour changes from what was left as is, and the deployment steps are numbered with the irreversible step marked. Dense but direct.
expl_justification.precisao: Every claim checked holds, many measured: the 9-column CONCAT UNION and mysqli::query ruling out stacked statements; the export race reproducing only across distinct sessions (12/12 and 719/720 corrupted on the original); the bcrypt rehash checking the column width, skipping NUL or 72+ byte passwords and equalizing failure timing; the backslash escape in the CSV; SUM/COUNT keeping the exact value; verChamado/tecnicoNome correctly kept as non-injectable.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding traces a concrete, reproduced path; the three access paths are tied to one missing visibility rule, and the N+1 is linked to the race window. The structural cost is weighed in Decisoes but not developed as a dedicated synthesis finding.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Findings run by severity (1 critica, 7 alta, 8 media, 8 baixa) with calibrated confidence (e.g. 55 for an unverifiable docroot exposure); the unfixed F25 is placed last. The deployment steps sequence operational risk precisely, with the ALTER as the point of no return, a backup and a rollback query.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Alternatives are compared throughout: new *Visivel functions against optional parameters, wildcards and tie order kept, HTTP 200 kept for not-found, the global average kept with its side channel acknowledged, bcrypt cost against CPU amplification, the dropped EXPORT_DIR file named as the main compatibility risk. As in E, AB, AM and AZ, declining the formula prefix for billing is not weighed.
